design: Fresh stationary starts; matched per-channel clocks; prespecified sides 4,8,12 and angular rates 0,1,8. Same initial connection within trajectory pairs across rates.

calculations.scope: Uniform independent raw connections: stationary mixture over conserved charges and components. Finite-cutoff memory integrals are not exact asymptotic mobility; sampling quadrature and tail errors are not in cluster SE.
